parameters.query:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT * FROM analysis_runs WHERE id = $1::uuid AND tenant_id = $2::text
), response AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'run_id', r.id::text,
    'history_id', r.history_id,
    'status', r.status,
    'current_step', r.current_step,
    'error', r.error,
    'created_at', r.created_at,
    'started_at', r.started_at,
    'finished_at', r.finished_at,
    'updated_at', r.updated_at,
    'progress', jsonb_build_object(
      'completed_steps', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_step_outputs s WHERE s.run_id = r.id AND s.status = 'completed'),
      'total_steps', 12
    ),
    'decision_state', r.decision_state,
    'report', (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'status', report.status,
        'markdown', report.markdown,
        'citations', report.citations,
        'asset_manifest', report.asset_manifest,
        'updated_at', report.updated_at
      )
      FROM analysis_reports report WHERE report.run_id = r.id
    ),
    'steps', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'step', s.step,
        'step_order', s.step_order,
        'status', s.status,
        'output', s.output,
        'updated_at', s.updated_at
      ) ORDER BY s.step_order)
      FROM analysis_step_outputs s WHERE s.run_id = r.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS body
  FROM selected_run r
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM response) THEN 200 ELSE 404 END AS http_status,
  COALESCE((SELECT body FROM response), jsonb_build_object('status', 'not_found', 'detail', 'analysis_run_not_found')) AS body;
